name: watch-headless
what: the headless watch runs a defect slice from the forecast to the packet and stops for the person; it does not merge

slice.title: An item that runs out today is missing from what runs out soon

baseline_prompt: Fix this defect in this repo. An item that runs out today is missing from the list of what runs out soon: the household asks for what runs out within three days on 2026-10-21, and milk that runs out on 2026-10-21 is missing from the answer. A recording of the requests and responses is at .xv/recordings/expiring-today.json. The whole suite runs with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`.
